notes.title: Thank you for all the amazing support!🔥
notes.content:
[b]We've hit 600 reviews in less than a week! Thank you for all the feedback <3 [/b]
Please don't hesitate to leave a Steam review if you haven't already - every single one is precious to us.

[b]HUGE thank you who bought at least one DLC[/b] - you make future games possible!
[b]Thank you who invested a bit of time to write a review[/b] - you help a lot! (◍•ᴗ•◍)❤
[b]Thank you who are a part of our incredible community.[/b] We did this for you, and we'll be making more games because you liked this one!

[h1]Our nearest future plans[/h1]
- Making the achievements more accessible.
- Enhancing the translations' quiality (currently in work). 
- Adding more languages.
- Voice-over improvements (for VO currently present in the game).
- Adding more voice-over languages.
- Various additional content for the game and for all of the DLCs, including user experience enhancements.
